verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly offer a copy-into-repo mode where 'nothing updates behind your back' and updates are pulled only via an explicit `npx skills update` command, giving an engineering lead control over when changes land (as opposed to the alternate 'managed, read-only, always-current' subscribe mode, which is opt-in, not forced). This directly addresses pinned/controlled updates vs silent changes. Missing for 10: explicit lockfile/version-pinning mechanism (e.g., versioned manifest file), independent/hands-on confirmation that `npx skills update` behaves as documented, and details on partial/selective update control.
